question: 最便宜的素菜和最贵的肉类各买两斤需要多少钱？

steps.description: Locate the vegetable section in the image, find the item labeled '红萝卜' (carrot), and read its price per unit
Locate the meat section in the image, find the item labeled '鲜鸡' (fresh chicken), and read its price per unit
Compare all vegetable prices to identify which one has the lowest price
Compare all meat prices to identify which one has the highest price
Multiply the price per unit of 红萝卜 (from step_1) by 2 to get the cost for 2 jin
Multiply the price per unit of 鲜鸡 (from step_2) by 2 to get the cost for 2 jin
Add the cost from step_5 and step_6 to get the total cost
